title: Automated Review Booster & Missed-Call Text-Back System
description: Deployment of a self-hosted, automated workflow engine that triggers instant text messages to missed calls and pushes review links to clients upon job completion.
assumptions: Reclaiming 4 hours a week from manual review outreach allows the owner to take on high-value jobs.
Automated instant text-backs successfully rescue at least 2 prospective clients a month from calling competitors.
Software tooling runs stable on lightweight container infrastructure without requiring ongoing maintenance retainers.
